SELECT i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county,
       AVG(cs_quantity::decimal(12,2)) AS agg1,
       AVG(cs_list_price::decimal(12,2)) AS agg2,
       AVG(cs_coupon_amt::decimal(12,2)) AS agg3,
       AVG(cs_sales_price::decimal(12,2)) AS agg4,
       AVG(cs_net_profit::decimal(12,2)) AS agg5,
       AVG(c_birth_year::decimal(12,2)) AS agg6,
       AVG(cd1.cd_dep_count::decimal(12,2)) AS agg7
FROM (
    SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_quantity, cs_list_price, cs_coupon_amt, cs_sales_price, cs_net_profit, c_birth_year, cd1.cd_dep_count
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk AND cd1.cd_gender = 'F' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
    JOIN date_dim d ON cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d_year = 2001
    LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON cs_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk AND ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN' ,'GA','MT','IN','CA') AND ca_country = 'USA'
    LEFT JOIN customer c ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk AND c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4) AND c_current_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
) subquery
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county)
ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
